mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_run_context (run_id, schema_version, main_agent_stage, base_context_ref, task_ledger_ref, runtime_control_ref, context_version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{runId}, #{schemaVersion}, #{mainAgentStage}, #{baseContextRef}, #{taskLedgerRef}, #{runtimeControlRef}, #{contextVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run_context SET main_agent_stage = #{context.mainAgentStage}, base_context_ref = #{context.baseContextRef}, task_ledger_ref = #{context.taskLedgerRef}, runtime_control_ref = #{context.runtimeControlRef}, context_version = #{context.contextVersion}, updated_at = #{context.updatedAt} WHERE run_id = #{context.runId} AND context_version = #{expectedVersion}
